sentences.text:
-----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary
-----

For the Petitioner : Mr. R.S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate Mr. Jazeb Iqbal, Advocate For the State : Mr.
Pankaj Kr. Mishra , A.P.P.
-----
Oral Order 04 / Dated : 10.01.2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Dhanbad P.S. Case No. 487 of 2022 (S.T. No. 249 of 2023) for the offence under Sections 376, 354A, 379, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-X, Dhanbad.
Earlier the prayer for bail of this petitioner was rejected by this Court on merit vide order dated 06.07.2023 passed in B.A. No. 4478 of 2023.
Prayer for bail of the petitioner is being renewed on the ground that the petitioner is in custody for more than two years and out of five witnesses, two have been examined.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is rejected again.
However, the Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial.
(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) AKT/Satendra Sonu Yadav @ Sonu Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp. ... on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140476585/
